name: platform_requirements
description: Returns every requirement allocated to a given platform, grouped by module and annotated with classification, DAL, and whether it is verified. Works via the two-hop pattern (:Platform)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Module)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Requirement) plus a direct (:Requirement)-[:ALLOCATED_TO]->(:Platform) match, so it catches both module-level allocation and explicit per-requirement allocation without double-counting. Results are module-grouped so an engineer sees the platform's responsibility surface organised the way the DOORS tree is organised.
when_to_use: Fire this template when the user asks for the requirements associated with a specific platform. Typical phrasings: 'all requirements allocated to Stratos-7', 'what is on AeroLynx-X2', 'Skyrunner-T1 requirement set', 'show me everything for Nimbus-C3'. The user must name exactly one platform. For cross-platform comparisons use Text2Cypher.

parameters.name: platform_name
parameters.description: The Platform.name. Must be one of the four fictional platforms: 'Stratos-7', 'AeroLynx-X2', 'Skyrunner-T1', 'Nimbus-C3'. Preserve the hyphenation and casing exactly.

cypher:
MATCH (p:Platform {name: $platform_name})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:ALLOCATED_TO]-(r1:Requirement)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:PART_OF]-(m:Module)-[:CONTAINS]->(r2:Requirement)
WITH p, collect(DISTINCT r1) + collect(DISTINCT r2) AS all_reqs
UNWIND all_reqs AS r
WITH DISTINCT p, r
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:VERIFIED_BY]->(t:TestProcedure)
WITH p, r, count(DISTINCT t) AS test_count
RETURN DISTINCT
       p.name                         AS platform,
       r.module                       AS module,
       r.id                           AS requirement_id,
       r.heading                      AS heading,
       r.summary                      AS summary,
       r.classification               AS classification,
       r.safety_classification        AS dal,
       CASE WHEN test_count > 0 THEN 'COVERED' ELSE 'GAP' END AS verification_status
ORDER BY module, requirement_id
notes: Allocation is captured two ways in AeroScope: explicitly via Requirement-[:ALLOCATED_TO]->Platform (fine-grained per-requirement assignment) and structurally via Module-[:PART_OF]->Platform (a shared module ships with every platform it belongs to). This template unions both, then DISTINCT-deduplicates, so requirements picked up by either mechanism are counted exactly once. The verification_status column makes this template composable with a follow-up orphan_requirements call when the user drills into gaps.
